updates.tweet_text: A big game changer for my winrate early on was realizing my job isn't to catch every move market makes. Its to - like a hunter - patiently wait on the small piece that corresponds to my edge. Realizing this, FOMO disappears and FOMO drives overtrading, chasing, and losses
updates.notes: Motivational/philosophical tweet about trading mindset. No prices, levels, or actionable references whatsoever.
